apple.name: Inborn: Private Local AI Chat
apple.subtitle: Offline On-Device LLM Chatbot
apple.promotional_text: Private AI chat that runs 100% on your phone. No account, no cloud, no analytics. Works in Airplane Mode. One-time purchase for Pro. Verify it yourself.
apple.description:
Inborn is an AI chat app that runs entirely on your phone. Turn on Airplane Mode and it still answers, at the same speed, because the model lives on your device and there is no server to reach.

Private is not a promise on a webpage here. You can check it in a minute, from outside the app:
- Airplane Mode: the chat keeps working with every radio off.
- Put it behind a firewall app and watch nothing appear. Inborn opens no connection by itself.
- Settings, Privacy & Security, App Privacy Report: Inborn contacts no domains unless you start a model download yourself.
- The Proof screen names the exact build you are running, and the source is public on GitHub under a source-available licence. Read it, build it, publish what you find.

What you get, all on-device:
- Unlimited chat with open models like Qwen and Phi, or import a GGUF file (Gemma, Mistral, Llama).
- Read and ask questions about your own PDFs and documents.
- Show it a photo or a screenshot and ask about it.
- Speak to it and hear it read back, with voices that run locally.
- A screen lock, an incognito mode that keeps nothing once the session ends, and an emergency wipe.

If you handle client material you cannot paste into a cloud, Pro for Work adds client vaults with their own passcode, a hash-chained audit log for each vault, signed records, and profession packs for legal, therapy, medical and accounting work.

Honest about limits: a small model on a phone is not a giant cloud model. Inborn tells you each model's name, how fast it runs on your exact device, and when a larger one would help.

There is no account. No email, no sign-in, nothing to create. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, ever. The privacy label is Data Not Collected.

Free is a complete app: full chat, no message limit, no watermark. Pro and Pro for Work are one-time purchases, never a subscription. Pro costs about what one month of a cloud AI subscription does, and it never renews.

Responses are generated by AI and can be wrong. Check anything that matters.

google.title: Inborn - Offline Local AI Chat
google.short_description: Private AI chat, no internet. Local LLM on your phone. No account, no cloud.
google.full_description:
Inborn is an offline AI chat app. The AI model runs 100% on your phone, so it works with no internet connection: on a plane, on the subway, abroad, or with Wi-Fi off. Nothing you type ever leaves your device.

This is a private AI chatbot you can verify, not just trust:
- On Android, Inborn has no Internet permission at all. Open App permissions on this page and look: there is no full network access. The app cannot go online.
- Turn on Airplane Mode and keep chatting. Same speed, same answers.
- Every check above happens outside the app, with no cooperation from us. The Proof screen names the exact build you are running, and the source is public on GitHub under a source-available licence: read it, build it, publish what you find.

Everything runs on-device:
- Unlimited offline AI chat with open local models like Qwen and Phi, or import a GGUF file (Gemma, Mistral, Llama): a local LLM in your pocket.
- Ask questions about your own PDFs and documents, offline.
- Show it a photo or a screenshot and ask about it, offline.
- Talk to it and hear replies, with on-device voices.
- Screen lock, an incognito mode that keeps nothing once the session ends, and emergency wipe.

For lawyers, therapists, journalists and anyone who handles client material that cannot go to a cloud, Pro for Work adds client vaults with their own passcode, a hash-chained audit log for each vault, signed records, and profession packs for legal, therapy, medical and accounting work.

Honest about limits: a small on-device model is not a giant cloud model. Inborn shows each model's name, how fast it runs on your device, and when a bigger one would help.

No account. No email or sign-in. No analytics, no ads, and no data collection of any kind. The Data safety section on this page reads: No data collected, no data shared.

Free is a complete app: unlimited chat, no message quota, no watermark. Pro and Pro for Work are one-time purchases, with no subscription and no quota. Pay once and keep it.

Content in Inborn is generated by AI and can be inaccurate. Please verify important information.

reviewer_notes:
Inborn runs an open-weight AI model entirely on the device. There is no backend server, no account and no login, so no demo account is needed.

TEST OFFLINE: The "Instant" model (Qwen3.5 0.8B, about 530 MB) ships inside the app bundle. Open the app, finish the short onboarding, turn on Airplane Mode and ask anything; it answers at the same speed. Larger models are optional: Vault > Install downloads one file (1.3 to 2.7 GB) over HTTPS from models.inbornapp.com, our own CDN, after a confirmation sheet that names the host and size. Models are data files (GGUF weights) run by the bundled llama.cpp engine; no executable code is downloaded. Hugging Face import is optional and asks first.

IN-APP PURCHASES (all non-consumable, all in this submission): inborn.pro (Pro, 19.99), inborn.work (Pro for Work, 69.99), inborn.work.upgrade (Work for existing Pro owners, 49.99, shown only after Pro is owned), inborn.pro.launch (Pro at the launch price 14.99, shown instead of inborn.pro only during the 30-day launch window built into this version; outside that window it is hidden by design). Settings > "See what's in Pro" opens the paywall; Restore purchases is on the paywall. Family Sharing is not enabled. The free tier is complete: unlimited chat, no message limit, no watermark.

AI CONTENT (Guideline 1.2): Answers are labeled as AI-generated in onboarding and in the chat, with a "can be wrong" notice. Family-safe mode is on by default (Settings > Chat > Family-safe mode): an on-device check of the request and the answer. To report an answer: long-press it > Report > pick a reason (including blocking the persona) > Save; reports stay on the device, and Settings > Reports can email them to support@inbornapp.com through the system mail sheet. The legal, therapy and medical packs in Pro for Work are drafting templates, not professional advice.

PRIVACY: Nothing the user types, says or shows leaves the device; App Privacy is "Data Not Collected". The privacy statement is in Settings and at https://inbornapp.com/privacy.

apple_subtitle.hypothesis: Keyword-max control: stacking the four core search terms (offline, on-device, LLM, chatbot) maximizes search reach. This is the spec default; treat as the baseline arm.
Proof-benefit framing beats keyword stacking on tap-to-install conversion, because the differentiator is trust, not category words.
Leading with the demand phrase 'Private AI' (App Store popularity 95) plus plain-language 'no internet' converts mainstream searchers better than the technical LLM/on-device register.
